rule: Rows whose expected results the pinned seed's native lane fixed (D7), written by `--freeze` before the VM ran them: the seed's bytes, the model tree they must equal, the source, the image and the run they give the VM (SPEC section 8) with the reference evaluation's calls. A row with no `seed` is by literal review: the seed cannot spell its Char keys, and types every program.

rows.name: keys-u32-3
rows.basis: a U32 Case with keys [10, 200, 30000] answers R0.. for them and R3 for any other word; queried at [0, 10, 11, 200, 201, 30000, 30001, 4294967295], of which 4 are computed

rows.name: keys-u32-5
rows.basis: a U32 Case with keys [10, 200, 3000, 40000, 500000] answers R0.. for them and R5 for any other word; queried at [0, 10, 11, 200, 201, 3000, 3001, 40000, 40001, 500000, 500001, 4294967295], of which 6 are computed

rows.name: keys-char-3
rows.basis: a Char Case with keys [65, 2048, 128512] answers R0.. for them and R3 for any other word; queried at [0, 65, 66, 2048, 2049, 128512, 128513, 1114111, 55296, 1114112, 4294967295], of which 7 are computed

rows.name: keys-char-5
rows.basis: a Char Case with keys [9, 32, 127, 128, 2047] answers R0.. for them and R5 for any other word; queried at [0, 9, 10, 32, 33, 127, 128, 129, 2047, 2048, 1114111, 57343], of which 6 are computed

rows.name: wide-3-flat
rows.basis: a constructor of 3 fields, the result itself, a different constructor at each position

rows.name: wide-3-nested
rows.basis: a constructor of 3 fields, first and last inside a constructor of 4, a different constructor at each position

rows.name: wide-5-flat
rows.basis: a constructor of 5 fields, the result itself, a different constructor at each position

rows.name: wide-5-nested
rows.basis: a constructor of 5 fields, first and last inside a constructor of 6, a different constructor at each position

rows.name: wide-9-flat
rows.basis: a constructor of 9 fields, the result itself, a different constructor at each position

rows.name: wide-9-nested
rows.basis: a constructor of 9 fields, first and last inside a constructor of 10, a different constructor at each position

rows.name: tags-shape
rows.basis: Shape has A and B without fields, C and D with; each of three tag Cases (all named, and two whose Default covers B and D, or A and C) is queried at A, B, C{On} and D{Off, On}, so a Default is reached by an immediate and by an Object

rows.name: ill-at-count
rows.basis: pick cases on a word `id` launders from Tri's C{} (an immediate of tag 2) at Flag, which has 2 constructors and no Default: section 6.1 inspects it as ill-typed

rows.name: ill-at-count-default
rows.basis: the same with a Default over On: the tag is still past the table

rows.name: ill-past-count
rows.basis: Tri's C{} at Solo, a one-constructor type: tag 2 is 2 past its end

rows.name: ill-fielded-branch
rows.basis: Tri's C{} at Shape, whose tag 2 has a field, named by a Branch: an immediate cannot name a constructor with fields

rows.name: ill-fielded-default
rows.basis: the same, named by the Default

rows.name: ill-nullary
rows.basis: Tri's B{} at Shape's nullary B: the control, admitted

rows.name: ill-scalar-action
rows.basis: a prim operand that is an Action (class 3) is ill-typed at U32: a class check that let class 3 pass as a Big cell would compute

rows.name: ill-describe-at-count
rows.basis: a Book's result word is read at its type: Tri's C{} (tag 2) at Flag (2 constructors) is ill-typed, not the next record's name

rows.name: ill-string-scalar
rows.basis: a String operand that is a large scalar's immediate word is ill-typed, not read as the address of a cell

rows.name: ill-string-action
rows.basis: an Action laundered to a String, with String at type index 1 = its foreign id and the empty String's word 1 for its operand, is ill-typed by its class
